description: Fresh capacity validation of Candidate G: retain its four-agent, 1,100-step scout-and-follow task and every policy setting, but increase each adjacent food patch from 30 to 50 units so delivery capacity no longer masks the pre-observed completion-speed difference.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. Candidate J can move to team review only when full-input PPO strictly beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on stochastic delivered food for seeds 7, 17 and 27. This remains development work; Phase 2B does not start from a single seed.
required_reports: per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
